services.name: Cabins
services.desc: At Southern Harbor Marina, we offer a tranquil escape on 200 acres of serene surroundings. Our fully furnished one-, two-, and three-bedroom cabins provide the perfect haven for any occasion. Many of our cabins feature spacious decks and patios overlooking the picturesque West Point Lake, allowing you to soak in its unmatched natural beauty. Equipped with all the essentials, these cabins ensure a comfortable and rejuvenating lakeside experience. Cabin reservations can be conveniently made on our website. blurb: Southern Harbor Marina is located on the Alabama side of West Point Lake, offering boat rentals, dockage, and cabins. The lake extends 35 miles along the Chattahoochee River with 525 miles of shoreline for fishing, camping, boating, and watersports. The marina provides amenities and services to support boating and recreational activities.

quotes.author: NATALIE R
quotes.text: It is simple, clean and rustic. You won’t be disappointed with the beautiful lake views. The cottages accommodated our large group perfectly. The cottages were very quiet and a nice respite after a busy day on the lake.

quotes.author: Tammy H.
quotes.text: It doesn’t get any better than this! Our cabin is clean and comfortable. Check in went well. Total relaxation just what we were looking for!

quotes.author: YVONNE G
quotes.text: Extremely nice staff. I love staying in the rustic cabins.
